name: Benchback
status: planned; Snapchat login page opened for user; no native Benchback build yet

theme.palette: warm white, amber source, teal tray, coral attention

assets.name: BenchbackMarkers
assets.description: Code-authored 6 cm source and tray ring markers with a distinct grip silhouette; animated connector follows saved locations. Intended as spatial annotations, not physical part replicas.

assets.name: BenchbackRecord
assets.description: Quiet 80ms confirmation for a committed spatial record

assets.name: BenchbackReturn
assets.description: Short soft cue when a part group is reconciled

assets.name: BenchbackAttention
assets.description: Restrained attention cue for an invalid, stale or duplicate action

labels: Mark source. Mark tray. Record the group.
Drag amber to the source; teal to the tray.
Align workspace to the original task
Save failed - progress may not survive closing

stateOwnership: BenchbackState owns ledger, draft metadata, counts, phase, active/reviewed group, intent revision and undo. BenchbackStorage handles validated checkpoints; UI is passive.
pipeline: Generate planned assets through CLAD skills; bootstrap semantic roots with VirtualScene; compile and inspect actual native preview; run each LEAF scenario separately.
verification: See test-plan.md and product-review.md. No Benchback tests have been run.
publication: Keep existing main until replacement works. Preserve old project in Git history. Do not submit the hackathon entry.
limits: User-marked source regions and counts; no physical recognition or installation verification
Local persistence is a required unimplemented feature; automatic physical relocalization is not claimed
Physical-glasses comfort, anchor accuracy and repair convenience remain unproven
revision: 2: local recovery, explicit resume alignment, flexible active group and quick record
workflow: First launch empty; resume prompt only when saved data exists
Place workspace and mark source/tray regions; default one part with optional metadata
Save accepted changes locally and verify readback
Suggest latest pending group; permit explicit activation of another pending group
Confirm one piece per unique intent; reject stale state/group events
Resume into manual alignment gate before enabling spatial returns
Undo accepted operations and recover the previous valid checkpoint

persistence.backend: PersistentStorageSystem.store / GeneralDataStore, subject to native verification
persistence.format: Versioned validated JSON, current and previous checkpoints with monotonically increasing revisions
persistence.save: At accepted state changes, verify readback before Saved status
persistence.resume: Restore data first; user confirms workspace alignment before actionable location guidance
persistence.failures: Visible storage or recovery error; no silent clearing of unsupported/corrupt data
persistence.physicalRelocalization: Not claimed; no automatic world-anchor recovery
